decision.observable: Every-ON generated mapped rows, qualified share delta, clip rejects, static float pre-post energy and GI trace GPU median
decision.pass: Mapped rows and triangles >0, share gain greater than absolute OFF-repeat spread, clip reject <0.04%, all capacities zero overflow, scene wait zero timeouts, static float mean within OFF repeat noise; image review preserves audited surfaces. Report cost even if high.
decision.reject: No gain beyond OFF repeats, energy loss beyond repeat noise, missing surfaces or capacity regression reject candidate for release; missing producer or captures INVALID.
